To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Football program rundown for Monday

Renee,

Here’s the rundown for the admin meeting and Dr. Pruitt’s board report.

We finished Friday with a 31–14 win over Brookhollow, which locks us into second in the region. Tavion Hurst rushed for 188 yards and two touchdowns. His long touchdown run in the third quarter was a highlight, but the line deserves a lot of credit too: they pushed Brookhollow back five yards on that whole drive. It was the best I’ve seen them block all year. The defense held Brookhollow to 46 rushing yards in the second half. Deshawn Pettaway had three sacks and seven tackles, and the kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met.

We’ve got a home playoff game against Clanton Valley this Friday, November 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please let Dr. Pruitt know we’re hosting and encourage folks to come out and support the team.

Academically, all 52 players are eligible after the nine-week grade check, with nobody on the ineligible list. Tonya’s Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason those grades are clean, and she deserves the credit. She’s keeping it going through the playoffs.

The booster club’s Boston butt sale brought in $6,240 from 208 butts, beating the $4,500 goal. That money is going toward the new sideline headsets. Hargrove’s Meat Market smoked them at cost, and the boosters are already organizing extra concession volunteers for the playoff game.

If we win and advance to an away game, I’ll get the bus information to you in time for the transportation request deadline. I’ll keep you posted after Friday.

Thanks,
Coach Tillman
